Equality of the square defect forces \(z+Tx=0\); invariance then forces \((1-x^2)y=0\), hence only the origin. The compact-slab obstruction follows by the same invariant-set argument, and Wirtinger applied to the exact derivative-energy balance gives \(P\ge2\pi/\sqrt T\); equality would be a single harmonic mode and substitution excludes it for \(R>0\). The inspected symbolic artifact verifies all derivative identities but is not the analytic proof.
